message: So, there I was, trying to make dinner and completely zoning out while the smoke alarm decided to throw a mini tantrum. In the midst of my kitchen chaos, my family group chat lit up with everyone checking in: "Is the kitchen on fire?" "Do we need to call 911?" It was hilarious and a bit chaotic, but it reminded me that having a plan really helps. We ended up laughing about it, but it’s a good nudge to make sure our escape plan is solid and that those smoke alarms are working! How do you keep your family in the loop about safety?
